subsystems.name: Clean sample handling
subsystems.role: keeps ancient, biomarker-poor rock from being polluted by modern organic matter.

subsystems.name: Extraction
subsystems.role: pulls free lipids out of powdered rock.
parts: accelerated solvent extractor or Soxhlet apparatus

subsystems.name: Fractionation
subsystems.role: splits the extract into chemical classes so the mass spectrometer is not swamped.

subsystems.name: Derivatisation
subsystems.role: makes polar molecules like sterols and fatty acids volatile enough to travel through a gas chromatograph.

subsystems.name: Gas chromatography–mass spectrometry
subsystems.role: separates individual molecular fossils and gives each a diagnostic mass spectrum.

subsystems.name: Isotope ratio mass spectrometry
subsystems.role: measures the carbon-13 content of a single molecule, revealing which carbon fixation pathway made it.

subsystems.name: Reference library and interpretation
subsystems.role: matches spectra and retention times to known biomarkers and known ages.

buildSteps.title: Collect uncontaminated samples
buildSteps.detail: Drill cores are preferred over surface outcrops; exposed faces and fissures that could carry younger oil or microbes are discarded, and samples are frozen or dried quickly.

buildSteps.title: Crush and extract
buildSteps.detail: Tens to hundreds of grams of rock are ground in a solvent-cleaned mill and repeatedly extracted hot with organic solvent until the lipids are released.

buildSteps.title: Clean and fractionate
buildSteps.detail: Elemental sulphur is removed with activated copper, then the extract is passed down a silica column and eluted into saturated hydrocarbon, aromatic and polar fractions.

buildSteps.title: Derivatise the polar fraction
buildSteps.detail: Alcohols and acids are converted to silyl esters and methyl esters so they will vaporise in the chromatograph.

buildSteps.title: Separate and identify
buildSteps.detail: Gas chromatography resolves the mixture; the mass spectrometer records spectra, and selected-ion monitoring at the hopane and sterane diagnostic masses picks out the molecular fossils.

buildSteps.title: Run blanks and standards
buildSteps.detail: Every batch includes solvent blanks and known standard mixtures; any compound that also appears in the blank is treated as contamination, not as a biosignature.

buildSteps.title: Measure carbon isotopes
buildSteps.detail: Individual peaks are routed through a combustion interface into an isotope ratio mass spectrometer to give a carbon-13 value per molecule.

buildSteps.title: Release bound biomarkers
buildSteps.detail: For very old or heavily altered rocks, hydropyrolysis is used to crack biomarkers out of the kerogen that has held them since deposition.

buildSteps.title: Interpret against context
buildSteps.detail: The biomarker assemblage and its isotopes are compared with the rock's age, thermal history and depositional setting before any claim about ancient life is made.

prerequisites.why: the workhorse that separates and identifies compounds at nanogram levels.
ties each molecule to the metabolism that produced it, not just its identity.

ancient rocks contain so little lipid that a fingerprint of modern carbon can overwhelm the signal; several high-profile Archean biomarker claims were later challenged as contamination from younger oil.
most biomarker carbon in very old rocks is bound in kerogen and only recoverable by catalytic cracking.
in-situ use on other planets needs instruments that survive launch, vacuum and radiation.

pathway.milestone: routine GC-MS and GC-IRMS biomarker work in petroleum and geobiology laboratories
pathway.unlocks: molecular records of bacteria and eukaryotes in rocks hundreds of millions of years old, and precise thermal-history models for oil exploration.

pathway.milestone: in-situ analysis on Mars with a rover-mounted GC-MS such as the ExoMars Rosalind Franklin rover's MOMA instrument
pathway.unlocks: screening of drilled samples for organic molecules before any sample is returned.

pathway.milestone: returned-sample analysis under ultra-clean protocols in terrestrial laboratories
pathway.unlocks: the contamination controls needed to make a convincing claim about extra-terrestrial lipids.

pathway.milestone: microfluidic lab-on-chip separations and automated spectral interpretation
pathway.unlocks: field-portable and ocean-world instruments that can search for biosignatures where no sample can be brought home.
